source: engine selector: default "sqlite" stores data on the container disk — set a PostgreSQL value to use the managed PostgreSQL database
storage selector: default "local" stores files on the container disk — set a value that stores files outside the container

findings.message: This app requires environment variables that have no value yet: VIKUNJA_DATABASE_TYPE, VIKUNJA_FILES_TYPE. Set them in the application's Configuration screen before deploying.
